chunks: Ahmad ibn al-Qattan narrated, saying: Abd al-Rahman ibn Muhammad al-Husayni narrated, saying: Abu al-Tayyib Muhammad ibn al-Husayn ibn Hamid al-Lakhmi narrated, saying: Abu Abdillah Muhammad ibn Zakariya narrated, saying: Muhammad ibn Abd al-Rahman al-Muhallabi narrated, saying: Abdillah ibn Muhammad ibn Sulayman narrated from his father, from Abdillah ibn al-Hasan, from his mother Fatima bint al-Husayn (peace be upon them both).
She said: When the illness of Fatima, daughter of Allah's Messenger, Allah's blessings be upon her, intensified,
the women of the Muhajirun and the Ansar gathered at her place and said to her: O daughter of Allah's Messenger, how have you become this morning from your illness?

She said: I have become at this morning, by Allah, one who will leave this world of yours and detests your men; I spat them before I chewed them, and I have become to disgust them after having examined them,
Hence, ugliness (be to them) due to the roundedness of the edges (of swords), weakness of the spears and clumsiness of opinions.
Moreover, evil is what their own selves presented for them, that (it caused) Allah to become angry at them, and that they are to abide in torment.
Assuredly, I had certainly bound the nooses to them and poured its shame upon them. Hence, may mutilation, slaughter and crushing afflict the oppressive people.

Woe to them, how did they remove it from the Mountains of the Message, the Foundations of Prophethood, the descension spot of the Trusted Revelation and the Knowledgeable of matters of materialism and Religion.
Alas, that is the clear loss!

Whatever they harbored of malice towards Abu Hasan, they harbored, and Allah will be, for his sake, in disavowal with His Sword. Severe shall His touch be, and by exemplary punishment shall His affliction be, due to his rage for the sake of Allah, Exalted and Glorious is He.

By Allah, if they had refrained from the ropes cast by Allah's Messenger, Allah's blessings be upon him and his Family, he would have taken it, and he would have walked with them in a suggestible manner by which its khashash will not cause injury, nor will its rider shake,
and he would have made them approach a good, high-flowing spring whose banks are full to the brim, and he would have sent them off while they are full.

He chose for them irrigation without seeking lawfulness to it with an enormous thing, except by a tumbler of water and the repelling of the evil of the famished. Moreover, the blessings of the Heaven and the earth would have opened to them.
Allah will take them for what they acquired.
Alas, come and hear. When you live (to see), life will show you wonder, and if you are wondered by the occurring,
to what buttress did they lean, and to what rope did they adhere?
They replaced, by Allah, that which is behind the tail for that which is before it, and the bottoms for the upper back.
Hence, there shall be spite against the sneezers for the disobediences of a people who assume that they are doing good.
Alas, they are, indeed, the causers of corruption, however, they do not sense.
«Is the one who guides to the truth more worthy of being followed, or the one who does not guide except that he is guided?» Hence, what is it with you, how do you judge?
Verily, by the religion of your God, I have become upset. Thus, wait a little, while you are producing,
then, (you may) seek to milk until the fullness of the large vessel, from tender blood and pungent venom.
There, the falsifiers will lose, and the followers will know the outcome of what the first established.
So, be pleasant for yourselves, and be confident for agitation due to tribulation, and hear the tidings of a cutting sword, an inclusive turmoil and despotism from the oppressors;
it will leave your booty small in size and your crops to be harvested.
How heartbreaking will that be for you! And how can assistance be sought from you, when you have been blinded? Shall we bind you to it while you are disliking it?
ai.seo_question: What did Fatima bint al-Husayn say to the women of the Muhajirun and Ansar during her illness?
ai.summary: In this narration from *Mani al-Akhbar*, Fatima bint al-Husayn (peace be upon her) delivers a profound critique to the women of the Muhajirun and Ansar, characterizing their men as having 'displaced' the Ahl al-Bayt from the foundations of prophethood and revelation. Her speech highlights the Shia theological view that the subsequent political rule was a deviation from divine appointment, resulting in spiritual corruption and the 'clear loss' of those who ignored the true leaders. This account serves as a key textual evidence for the early recognition of the Ahl al-Bayt's unique status and the consequences of their marginalization.
